decisions.reason: Identifies the dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 from running-processes.txt as the koffi.node loader and explains the OS keeps the native binary locked until that process exits, so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY; file-in-use/lock wording is equivalent.

Explicitly states a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the koffi-owning host stays alive, and gives an ordered stop-verify-install-restart procedure as numbered steps, without prescribing killing unrelated Node processes.

Grounds the diagnosis in npm-dist-tags.txt: an unpinned global install resolves to latest (0.1.1-rc.2), silently replacing/downgrading the running 0.1.2-alpha.4 instead of upgrading it; the resolution mechanism is correct, so the minor aside about semver range matching does not detract.

Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping dsh processes, verifies dsh --version prints 0.1.2-alpha.5 and restarts; @alpha is presented only as a mutable alternative, not a replacement.

Tells README authors to pin the exact version whenever a plugin install command also installs dsh and warns that a bare name silently follows latest, which can downgrade users on pre-release channels; presented as the report's own recommendation, not an endorsed bad example.
